claim: Demo sample data stays separate from real practice data.
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo, captures the demo workspace token, and asserts every demo API request includes only that workspace; a fixture real-practice record is not returned or mutated.

claim: Reset demo starts a fresh set of sample bookings.
sandbox: Fresh /demo workspace changes the seeded recovery state, selects Reset demo, and asserts a new demo token and the original seeded booking states are visible.

claim: A recovery message needs recorded contact consent.
sandbox: Demo data includes one unfinished attempt without email consent. Attempting recovery leaves no outbound message in its case and shows the consent explanation.

claim: The demo shows a receipt after a sample recovery action.
sandbox: Fresh demo selects the consented unfinished booking, runs the accelerated sample recovery, and asserts a timestamped simulated email receipt and case outcome are visible.

claim: Demo does not contact payment, messaging, sign-in, or AI services.
sandbox: Playwright records every request for the full fresh-demo flow and asserts each URL is same-origin; no request is made to Stripe, a messaging provider, Entra, Sociobot billing, or the AI gateway.
